title: Top11 Editpoints And Controlpoints

positive: a line exposes 2 control points and 2 edit points; a NURBS 4 of each; a circle exposes centre+4 quadrants and dragging a quadrant sets radius 5; a two-segment polycurve exposes 4 control points and editing one changes its segment; a 2x2 surface exposes 4 control grips and 4 edit grips; moving an edit grip to (3,3,2) reaches that point, and a periodic/reversed cylinder keeps its record; F10 and Esc behave as documented
negative: points toggle without a curve/surface selection
toggle while a Top 11 command is pending
grip drag with an out-of-range index or singular placement
